commit.message:
Add some repo URLs

in many cases just copies of url, partly automated
libiconv: add CP65001 as alias for UTF-8

libiconv: fix Makefile.devel assuming GCC

Fixes build failures on CLANG64 and CLANG32.

libiconv: make patched genaliases.c generate...
...code in line with gperf-generated code

libiconv: patch genaliases instead of gen'd files

The original fix-pointer-buf.patch patched the encoding-*.h files
manually, which possibly explains why things weren't upstreamed.

Changed fix-pointer-buf.patch to patch whatever is generating these
files, instead of the generated files themselves.
libiconv: update autogenned files after patching

Make sure every package using a C/C++ compiler depends on one

The "cc" virtual package provides the environment default compiler.
Enable clang32 for all packages already in the repo
Enable clang64 for all packages already in the repo
